tagline: No hero at all — six clones, and every card counts how many showed up

featuredCards.title: Elite Strategy
featuredCards.caption: Drops a clone anywhere on the board. Every number in this deck is really a headcount.

featuredCards.title: Transport Carrier
featuredCards.caption: Moves every clone five spaces through anything and hands back an action. The squad relocates as one.

featuredCards.title: Tactical Assault
featuredCards.caption: A printed 1 that climbs with each brother already standing in your zone. Surround first, swing second.

featuredCards.title: Execute order 66
featuredCards.caption: One damage per clone in that fighter's zone, with no combat to win. The swarm collects.
